terms.label: data access service
terms.definition: A site or end-point that gives access to the distribution of the dataset.

terms.label: access address
terms.definition: A URL of a resource that gives access to a distribution of the dataset. E.g. landing page, feed, SPARQL endpoint. Use for all cases except a simple download link, in which case downloadURL is preferred.

terms.label: bounding box
terms.definition: The geographic bounding box of a spatial thing [SDW-BP].

terms.label: byte size
terms.definition: The size of a distribution in bytes.

terms.label: catalog
terms.definition: A catalog that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: centroid
terms.definition: The geographic center (centroid) of a spatial thing [SDW-BP].

terms.label: compression format
terms.definition: The compression format of the distribution in which the data is contained in a compressed form, e.g. to reduce the size of the downloadable file.

terms.label: contact point
terms.definition: Relevant contact information for the catalogued resource. Use of vCard is recommended.

terms.label: dataset
terms.definition: A dataset that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: distribution
terms.definition: An available distribution of the dataset.

terms.label: download URL
terms.definition: The URL of the downloadable file in a given format. E.g. CSV file or RDF file. The format is indicated by the distribution's dcterms:format and/or dcat:mediaType.

terms.label: end date
terms.definition: The end of the period.

terms.label: description of service end-point
terms.definition: A description of the service end-point, including its operations, parameters etc.

terms.label: service end-point
terms.definition: The root location or primary endpoint of the service (a web-resolvable IRI).

terms.label: first
terms.definition: The first resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.

terms.label: hadRole
terms.definition: The function of an entity or agent with respect to another entity or resource.

terms.label: has current version
terms.definition: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource with equivalent content [PAV].

terms.label: has version
terms.definition: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource [PAV].

terms.label: in series
terms.definition: A dataset series of which the dataset is part.

terms.label: keyword
terms.definition: A keyword or tag describing a resource.

terms.label: landing page
terms.definition: A Web page that can be navigated to in a Web browser to gain access to the catalog, a dataset, its distributions and/or additional information.

terms.label: last
terms.definition: The last resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.

terms.label: media type
terms.definition: The media type of the distribution as defined by IANA

terms.label: packaging format
terms.definition: The package format of the distribution in which one or more data files are grouped together, e.g. to enable a set of related files to be downloaded together.

terms.label: previous
terms.definition: The previous resource (before the current one) in an ordered collection or series of resources.

terms.label: previous version
terms.definition: The previous version of a resource in a lineage [PAV].

terms.label: qualified relation
terms.definition: Link to a description of a relationship with another resource.

terms.label: record
terms.definition: A record describing the registration of a single dataset or data service that is part of the catalog.

terms.label: resource
terms.definition: A resource that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: serves dataset
terms.definition: A collection of data that this DataService can distribute.

terms.label: service
terms.definition: A service that is listed in the catalog.

terms.label: spatial resolution (meters)
terms.definition: minimum spatial separation resolvable in a dataset, measured in meters.

terms.label: start date
terms.definition: The start of the period

terms.label: temporal resolution
terms.definition: minimum time period resolvable in a dataset.

terms.label: theme
terms.definition: A main category of the resource. A resource can have multiple themes.

terms.label: theme taxonomy
terms.definition: The knowledge organization system (KOS) used to classify catalog's datasets.

terms.label: version
terms.definition: The version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
